canonical_payload.head: codex/lifecycle-broker-failure-evidence-20261010
canonical_payload.title: fix: preserve bounded lifecycle broker failure evidence
canonical_payload.body:
Natural Dispatcher run 38038327887 failed on PR1677 stale convergence, but the shell replaced the protected broker response with LIFECYCLE_BROKER_NOT_VERIFIED and lost its original reason. Preserve only bounded state/reason/failure-code labels and a boolean mutation observation in the fail-closed receipt before replacement; omit arbitrary text, tokens and credentials.

Validation: 58 actual-shell, broker lifecycle and protected dispatch tests passed, including drain HOLD, original-fence HOLD, malformed response and secret redaction. This change preserves existing authority, single-call and no-retry boundaries. It does not resolve or claim the historical broker denial or authorize provider activation or promotion.
